title: US prosecutors charge three people affiliated with Super Micro, including a co-founder, with smuggling Nvidia chips to China; SMCI drops 11.85% after hours (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
summary: Jordan Novet / CNBC: US prosecutors charge three people affiliated with Super Micro, including a co-founder, with smuggling Nvidia chips to China; SMCI drops 11.85% after hours — The U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York has charged associates of an unidentified U.S. server maker …
